title: GROUP BY with ROLLUP in SQL
definition: ROLLUP is an extension of GROUP BY that generates subtotal rows and a grand total row along with grouped data.

basic_rollup_syntax.heading: Basic ROLLUP Syntax
basic_rollup_syntax.query: SELECT p_name, SUM(total_price) FROM billing_info GROUP BY ROLLUP(p_name);

rollup_example.heading: ROLLUP Example
rollup_example.query: SELECT p_name, SUM(total_price) FROM billing_info GROUP BY ROLLUP(p_name);

handling_null_values.heading: Handling NULL values in ROLLUP
handling_null_values.definition: ROLLUP creates a NULL row for the grand total. COALESCE is used to replace NULL with a meaningful label.
handling_null_values.query: SELECT COALESCE(p_name, 'TOTAL') AS product, SUM(total_price) FROM billing_info GROUP BY ROLLUP(p_name);

interview_tip.heading: Interview Tip
points: ROLLUP is mainly used for reporting
It automatically adds subtotal and grand total rows
